s: LORD watches over those who fear him (those who hope in his loving kindness)
q: Behold, the LORD’s eye is on those who fear him, on those who hope in his loving kindness,

s: LORD is help and shield of the speakers
q: He is our help and our shield.

s: LORD has holy name trusted by the speakers
q: because we have trusted in his holy name.

s: David pretended to be insane (before Abimelech)
q: By David; when he pretended to be insane before Abimelech, who drove him away, and he departed.

s: LORD redeems soul of his servants
q: The LORD redeems the soul of his servants.

s: LORD is near to broken-hearted (also saves the crushed in spirit)
q: The LORD is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit.

s: LORD's angel encamps around those who fear him (those who fear the LORD)
q: The LORD’s angel encamps around those who fear him, and delivers them.

s: those who fear him (those who fear the LORD) lack nothing (no lack with those who fear him)
q: for there is no lack with those who fear him.

s: those who fear him (those who fear the LORD) are called saints
q: Oh fear the LORD, you his saints

s: the righteous experiences many afflictions (LORD delivers from them all)
q: Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but the LORD delivers him out of them all.

s: the righteous has protected bones (none broken)
q: He protects all of his bones. Not one of them is broken.

s: the wicked will be killed by evil
q: Evil shall kill the wicked.

s: Abimelech drove away David (after David pretended insanity)
q: By David; when he pretended to be insane before Abimelech, who drove him away, and he departed.

s: children are taught by David (the fear of the LORD)
q: Come, you children, listen to me. I will teach you the fear of the LORD.
